capabilities: Manage vocabulary books as Canvas files with colored cards
Highlight vocabulary words in editing, reading, and PDF views
Show definitions and pronunciation on hover
Generate AI definitions via a configurable API provider
Track word mastery and list current-document words in a sidebar
extras: AI feature is disabled by default and only sends word and sentence text on manual use; data is stored locally in the vault and works offline by default.
motivation: To turn reading into an immersive vocabulary learning experience by combining highlighting, instant definitions, and mastery tracking.
problem: Reading in Obsidian offers no way to mark, review, and learn unfamiliar words in place while reading notes or PDFs.
summary: Vocabulary-learning plugin that highlights words from Canvas-based vocabulary books, shows definitions on hover, and offers AI-generated definitions.
